component.name: BobFWTools Studio
component.summary: Phoenix Forge Mobile Hardware, USB Telemetry, and Firmware Workbench

description.p: BobFWTools Studio (Phoenix Forge) is a local-first mobile hardware diagnostics, USB descriptor enumeration, and firmware servicing workbench for Linux, macOS (12.0+), and Windows (10/11).

Supported device families include Apple iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch (Normal, Recovery 05ac:1281, and DFU 05ac:1227 modes) alongside 20+ Android OEMs and bare-metal silicon boot modes (Samsung Odin, Google Pixel, Motorola, Xiaomi, OnePlus/OPPO/Realme, Sony, ASUS, Nothing, LG, HTC, Huawei/Honor, ZTE/RedMagic, Lenovo, TCL/Alcatel/T-Mobile REVVL, Fairphone, Qualcomm EDL 9008, MediaTek BROM/Preloader, and Unisoc FDL).

Phoenix Forge 5.0.0: Obsidian Studio UI redesign, macOS 12.0+ Universal 2 binary support, Windows 10/11 MSIX & Win32 store readiness, and Linux udev + AppDir/Snap/Flatpak support across 150+ Apple models and 20+ Android OEMs.
